judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The pet frog in a burning house, the 'Loads and loads of money?' reply to an unspoken player line, the '?!' punctuation, the unspaced ellipses and the short flat townsfolk lines ('Oh no...I've lost everything.', 'Well good luck to ya') are Westwood's goofy, unpolished Nox register through and through.
